0022600181.text: The Timberwolves (5-3, third in the Northwest and seventh in the West) visit the Rockets (7-1, first in the Southwest and first in the West) for Minnesota's ninth game of the season, with Houston riding a two-game winning streak and a 4-0 home record. Minnesota is without Anthony Edwards (knee surgery), Donte DiVincenzo (Achilles surgery) and Terrence Shannon Jr. (hip bruise), while Houston is missing Clint Capela (ankle sprain) and Steven Adams (calf strain). The teams have not met yet this season, and Minnesota won the 2025-26 series 2-1, including a 136-132 road win in Houston on April 10, 2026.
